title: Predictive Memory Localization: Forecasting Selective Intervention Paths from Internal Signals
abstract: arXiv:2608.12892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering turns localized representations into control directions, but localization alone does not reveal whether a direction has a selective operating regime. We introduce Predictive Memory Localization (PML), which treats the measured-grid intervention path as the predictive object of memory localization. PML separates random-calibrated target movement from semantic-neighbor and capability damage, and compares static localization and supervised geometry with a strength-disjoint low-dose causal response. Our frozen study covers 3,000 records from nine datasets and fourteen domains, yielding 30,000 distinct record-direction-layer paths and 210,000 distinct path-strength evaluations. At layer 7, the geometry-derived RFM/AGOP direction reaches 13.1% target-any and 12.3% clean-any, exceeding random by 3.6 and 3.4 percentage points under a record-paired bootstrap. translated_title: 预测性记忆定位：从内部信号预测选择性干预路径
translated_abstract: 激活引导将局部化表示转化为控制方向，但局部化本身并不能揭示一个方向是否具有选择性操作区间。我们引入了预测性记忆定位（PML），它将测量网格干预路径视为记忆定位的预测对象。PML将随机校准的目标移动与语义邻居和能力损伤区分开来，并将静态局部化和监督几何与强度分离的低剂量因果响应进行比较。我们的冻结研究涵盖来自九个数据集和十四个领域的3000条记录，产生30,000条不同的记录-方向-层路径和210,000次不同的路径强度评估。在第7层，基于几何的RFM/AGOP方向达到了13.1%的目标任意性和12.3%的清洁任意性，在记录配对自助法下超过随机3.6和3.4个百分点。在记录、数据集和领域分组划分中，响应在$|。
tldr: 本文提出预测性记忆定位（PML）方法，通过将干预路径作为预测对象，有效分离随机校准目标移动与语义损伤，并在大规模多领域实验中证明其优于随机基线，为激活引导的选择性操作提供了预测性评估框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Predictive Memory Localization (PML), which treats intervention paths as predictive objects to separate random-calibrated target movement from semantic damage, demonstrating superior selective operation over random baselines across large-scale multi-domain experiments.
